description: MERGE inside an explicit transaction sees its target through the transaction overlay: rows INSERTed earlier in the same transaction match ON and are updatable/deletable, pending UPDATEs of committed rows are visible, and rows DELETEd in the same transaction are not resurrected as MATCHED. Converted 1:1 from transaction/MergeTargetOverlayTest (now retired).

steps.sql: CREATE TABLE agg_tmp (k VARCHAR, v NUMBER)
CREATE TABLE feed (k VARCHAR, amt NUMBER)

MERGE INTO agg_tmp t USING (SELECT k, amt FROM feed) AS s (k2, v2)
ON t.k = s.k2
WHEN MATCHED THEN UPDATE SET t.v = s.v2
SELECT k, v FROM agg_tmp ORDER BY k
CREATE TABLE agg_tmp (k VARCHAR, v NUMBER)
CREATE TABLE feed (k VARCHAR, amt NUMBER)

MERGE INTO agg_tmp t USING (SELECT k FROM feed) AS s (k2)
ON t.k = s.k2
WHEN MATCHED THEN DELETE
CREATE TABLE agg_tmp (k VARCHAR, v NUMBER)
CREATE TABLE feed (k VARCHAR, amt NUMBER)
UPDATE agg_tmp SET k = 'a' WHERE k = 'renamed'

MERGE INTO agg_tmp t USING (SELECT k, amt FROM feed) AS s (k2, v2)
ON t.k = s.k2
WHEN MATCHED THEN UPDATE SET t.v = s.v2
CREATE TABLE agg_tmp (k VARCHAR, v NUMBER)
CREATE TABLE feed (k VARCHAR, amt NUMBER)

MERGE INTO agg_tmp t USING (SELECT k, amt FROM feed) AS s (k2, v2)
ON t.k = s.k2
WHEN MATCHED THEN UPDATE SET t.v = s.v2
WHEN NOT MATCHED THEN INSERT (k, v) VALUES (s.k2, s.v2)
SELECT k, v FROM agg_tmp ORDER BY k
